scope: Complete local FFU SHA-256 and chunk verification in a production browser worker
browser: Headless Microsoft Edge, production Vite worker and Rust/WASM

checks.label: Image fingerprint
checks.message: Complete local file SHA-256: ce4724a1e4225f629ee4092400715dcd85d160470e1173c71c8065527e73e8c4. Recorded for later revalidation.

checks.label: Chunk integrity
checks.message: All 13090 FFU SHA-256 chunks checked; this does not authenticate the signing catalog.

checks.label: Catalog signature
checks.message: RSA/SHA-256 catalog signature and signed attributes verified. This does not establish signer trust or device acceptance.

checks.label: Signed hash-table binding
checks.message: Signed catalog member matches the FFU hash table using legacy SHA-1. Legacy collision resistance is not a modern authenticity guarantee.

checks.label: Firmware signer trust
checks.message: An embedded certificate is not a trust anchor. OEM chain, device root-key binding, certificate policy/time and revocation have not been validated.

checks.label: Firmware version in image
checks.message: Image firmware revision is 3051.50009.1424.0002. Sources: MainOS/Windows/Packages/RegistryFiles/Nokia.DeviceInfo.PhoneFirmwareRevision.reg: HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SYSTEM\Platform\DeviceTargetingInfo\PhoneFirmwareRevision; MainOS/Windows/Packages/DsmFiles/Nokia.DeviceInfo.PhoneFirmwareRevision.dsm.xml: Identity/Version. This observed metadata does not establish signer trust.

checks.label: Installed / image firmware
checks.message: The image is numerically older within the same firmware branch. No downgrade acceptance/profile is validated; recovery remains blocked.

checks.label: Recovery execution
checks.message: Stock recovery currently runs only in protocol replay tests. No physical-device executor is enabled.

phone_comparison.source: Previously recorded redacted phone metadata; no fresh USB queries

limits: Hashes establish integrity against the supplied table, not independent OEM trust or exact device applicability.
Same-branch older firmware remains blocked because downgrade acceptance is unvalidated.
Cancelled, failed-read, changed-header and incomplete sessions publish no complete checklist; payload mismatches publish a failed check with the actual full-file digest.
Files above 4 GiB are exercised through bounded metadata construction, not a complete hardware/browser multi-gigabyte validation run. The real browser file is 1,716,256,768 bytes.
No proprietary firmware bytes, serial numbers, public IDs, personal paths or loader data are published.
